Adding Movies

The flow is the same as series — no episode structure to worry about.

Adding a movie

1

Movies → Add Movie

Search by title. NGMS queries TMDB and shows posters, release year, and runtime.

2

Configure

Set Quality Profile, Root Folder, and Monitored toggle. If monitored, NGMS will search for the movie automatically once it passes its release date.

3

Add

Click Add Movie. If the movie is already past its release date and you enabled monitoring, NGMS queues an immediate search. Otherwise it waits for the release date (checked daily via the scheduler).

Availability thresholds

NGMS respects TMDB's availability flags. You can configure a minimum availability threshold per-movie or globally in Settings:

ThresholdWhen NGMS starts searching
AnnouncedImmediately after adding (even if months before release)
In CinemasOnce TMDB marks the film as in cinemas
ReleasedOnce TMDB marks a digital/physical release (recommended)

Bulk import from lists

NGMS supports adding movies in bulk from sources like the Plex Watchlist, TMDB lists, or the Discover page. From Discover, hover a poster and click Add to Library to add it with your default profile and root folder.

ℹ
Movies are organized into a single folder per film: /media/movies/Movie Title (2024)/Movie Title (2024).mkv. The folder and filename pattern can be customized in Settings → Media Management → Movie Naming.
